module_summary: MUX-based CDC synchronizer: clk_a registers data and enable, the enable passes a two-flop clk_b synchronizer, then gates loading data_reg into dataout.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: clk_a-domain register holding data_in stable for capture by the clk_b output mux

anchors.name: en_clap_two
anchors.why: Second synchronizer flop; synchronized enable selecting data_reg into dataout

anchors.name: dataout
anchors.why: clk_b-domain output register, loads data_reg when synchronized enable is high, else holds

anchors.name: en_data_reg
anchors.why: clk_a-domain registered copy of data_en feeding the clk_b synchronizer chain

anchors.name: data_en
anchors.why: Input qualifier marking data_in valid for transfer across domains

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 4-bit clk_a-domain data payload captured into data_reg

anchors.name: en_clap_one
anchors.why: First clk_b synchronizer flop for the enable, feeds en_clap_two

groups.name: clk_a capture registers
groups.description: Registers data_in and data_en in the source clk_a domain

groups.name: enable synchronizer
groups.description: Two clk_b flip-flops synchronizing the registered enable

groups.name: output mux register
groups.description: clk_b register choosing data_reg or hold value under synchronized enable
